observations.beam_cue_assessment: raised tile glyph reads as an abstract branch or Y rather than an unmistakable phone/beam direction
observations.evidence_class: independent native-agent digital visual judgment over exact sealed projections, metrics, source, and renders

indexed_state_assessment.fox: ambiguous antelope, giraffe, antennaed creature, squirrel, or fox
indexed_state_assessment.owl: ambiguous bat, butterfly, mask, or owl

limitations: No human play, recognition, delight, finite phone emitter, normal-room contrast, first-use behavior, physical use, or durability was observed.
observations.reset_cue_assessment: fixed arrow is visible only on isolated shell view; assembled pointer-to-double-V pairing is not shown
observations.summary: Coverage is complete and the eclipse wipe is truthful, but fox and owl remain ambiguous without captions and assembled reset/beam cue discovery is not demonstrated.
observations.transition_interpretation: truthful eclipse wipe between indexed animals; no continuous-recognition claim

checks.evaluator: Codex root deterministic replay plus independent native mechanical reviewer

observations.evidence_class: isolated exact-source fit/spec/motion replay plus independent source audit
limitations: No printed detent force or feel, latch insertion force or strain, snap survival, retention force, printer compensation, tipping/load behavior, pinch safety, strength, or cycle life was tested.
observations.summary: The round-two detent, closure-path, and stand-endpoint defects are addressed in bounded digital evidence.

checks.evaluator: Codex root exact-STL replay plus independent native printability reviewer

observations.evidence_class: deterministic exact-STL hash, mesh, bed, standard wall, and explicit fine rear-wall replay
limitations: No slicer, support analysis, successful print, warping, layer adhesion, physical fit, snap compliance, strength, or cycle test was performed.
observations.summary: All four exact meshes and standard wall replays pass, but the sealed fine report names an older candidate and the exact current rear STL fails the explicit 0.16-mm requested-voxel wall replay.

feedback.area: indexed fox/owl recognition and reset/beam cue discovery
feedback.change: Use compact triangular fox ears with a clearer low muzzle/brush; give the owl decisive eye/beak negative space or a clearer external beak and less bat-like lower lobes; add an assembled wall-side view pairing the fixed pointer with the home V; replace the abstract tile glyph with an unmistakable phone/flashlight/beam arrow.
feedback.finding: The exact coverage is complete, but fox ear stalks read as horns or antennae, the owl can read as a bat/butterfly/mask, the assembled pointer-to-home-V pairing is not shown, and the phone-side tile glyph does not unambiguously communicate beam direction.

feedback.area: rear-shell minimum wall and current-artifact evidence binding
feedback.change: Repair the rear-shell knife edge at the cited location in source, regenerate the exact rear STEP/STL, and produce a passing fine report bound to that new sealed rear STL before repeating Playtest.
feedback.finding: The sealed fine report measures an older product-candidate rear STL, while a fine replay on the exact sealed rear STL finds one 0.26 mm sample below the 0.8 mm wall threshold at (-53.6, -37.9, 3.2) and returns WALL BELOW MINIMUM.
